projects.title: Class-Spy
projects.summary: Turns utility classes into readable CSS at the point of use, so developers can inspect an unfamiliar interface without breaking their flow.
projects.challenge: Resolve CSS and Tailwind utilities consistently across HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Astro and Angular while keeping hover feedback immediate.
decisions: Framework-aware parsing instead of one generic regex pass
AST-assisted inspection so a resolved class maps back to its source
Low-latency editor feedback — the hover card is the product
projects.ownership: Designed and built the extension experience and parsing flow end to end.

callouts.text: The class attribute under the cursor, framework-aware.
Each utility resolved to the declaration it produces.
Status strip: frameworks covered, language, inspection state.

projects.title: Episode Roulette
projects.summary: A Chrome and Safari WebExtension that injects a Random Episode button into Netflix and Prime Video series pages, discovering every episode across all seasons and picking one with equal probability.
projects.challenge: Discover every episode across all seasons inside SPAs fully controlled by Netflix and Prime Video, with no external APIs, then start playback as if the user had clicked it themselves.
decisions: MutationObserver-driven detection instead of brittle selectors-on-load
Equal-probability randomizer across the discovered episode set
Platform-native UI so the button looks like it shipped with the player
projects.ownership: Built discovery, the probability model, and the native playback integration.

callouts.text: The button is injected into the series page, not a separate app.
Season-by-season episode discovery, counted per season.
One episode picked at equal probability from the full set.

projects.title: Habitual
projects.summary: A cross-device habit system designed around clear routines, visible momentum, and a focused daily workflow.
projects.challenge: Model recurring behaviour and progress so it stays simple for the person using it, while supporting a modern full-stack application architecture underneath.
decisions: Reusable React UI rather than per-screen components
API-first data flow so clients share one contract
Progress-focused product model — momentum is the metric, not streaks
projects.ownership: Shaped the product model, the reusable UI, and the API-first data flow.

specimen.caption: Daily workflow — momentum at a glance

callouts.text: Momentum as the headline number, not a gamified streak.
The week at a glance: completed days are the only filled state.
Each habit carries its own run length, so the list stays scannable.

projects.title: Smart Education Bot
projects.summary: A PDF question-answering system that combines document extraction, contextual NLP responses, and a web fallback path.
projects.challenge: Find useful answers in unstructured educational material while keeping a fallback for the queries the local source cannot resolve.
decisions: Document-first retrieval before reaching for the web
BERT-based context so answers are grounded in the source text
Graceful web fallback when the document has no answer
projects.ownership: Built document extraction, the question-answering path, and the fallback flow.

specimen.caption: Document answer with a confidence read-out

callouts.text: The source document is named — the answer is traceable to it.
The answer is extracted context, not a chat reply.
Confidence is shown, so a weak answer is visibly weak.
